title: The way in
goals: Do it in fewer than 9 lines.
starting_code:
# A gate that listens waits for you
# Two seals block the way beyond it
hints: Walk right one step and say ambrel.
Walk to the first door and cast zelim.
Walk down two steps. Then move left four steps to the second door.
intro: We are almost at the castle. A gate that listens blocks the way. Two sealed doors block the way too. Show me what you can do!
outro: We made it! The castle of Arvelia looks so big up close.
